edits.modify_from: Number of container pick-ups completed. Start at 0. If any execution step shown at this decision step says a container is held in the gripper, write carried-in value + 1; otherwise copy the carried-in value. e.g. 1
edits.modify_to: Number of container pick-ups completed so far, always written as a number, never left blank. If no value was carried in (as at the first decision step), treat the carried-in value as 0. Then, if any execution step shown at this decision step shows a container held in the gripper, write that number + 1; otherwise write that number unchanged. It does not change when the container is put down. At the first decision step this is 0. e.g. 0 at the first decision step, 1 after one container has been lifted
